<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Vatara Pet Healthcare & Veterinary Clinic</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;600;700&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Noto+Serif+Bengali:wght@500;600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Bengali:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0b0905;
    --bg-panel:#151109;
    --bg-panel-2:#1c160c;
    --gold:#c9a24a;
    --gold-bright:#eecf8d;
    --gold-dim:#8a7239;
    --cream:#f4eee0;
    --muted:#b6a889;
    --line: rgba(201,162,74,0.30);
    --font-display:'Cormorant Garamond','Noto Serif Bengali',serif;
    --font-body:'Jost','Noto Sans Bengali',sans-serif;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation-duration:0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.001ms !important;}
  }
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--cream);
    font-family:var(--font-body);
    font-weight:300;
    line-height:1.6;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  .wrap{max-width:1140px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  .bn{font-family:'Noto Serif Bengali','Noto Sans Bengali',serif;}

  /* ---------- texture ---------- */
  .bg-texture{
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:-1; pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 500px at 50% -10%, rgba(201,162,74,0.10), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 600px at 100% 100%, rgba(201,162,74,0.05), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
  }

  /* ---------- nav ---------- */
  header{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(11,9,5,0.86);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  nav.wrap{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    height:76px;
  }
  .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
  .brand img{height:42px; width:42px; object-fit:contain;}
  .brand-text{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.1;}
  .brand-text .en{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:1.18rem; letter-spacing:0.03em; color:var(--gold-bright);}
  .brand-text .bn2{font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .navlinks{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:30px;}
  .navlinks a{font-size:0.92rem; color:var(--cream); position:relative; padding:4px 0;}
  .navlinks a .bn{display:block; font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--muted);}
  .navlinks a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .25s ease;}
  .navlinks a:hover::after, .navlinks a:focus-visible::after{width:100%;}
  .cta-btn{
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    color:var(--gold-bright) !important;
    padding:9px 18px;
    font-size:0.86rem;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    white-space:nowrap;
    transition:background .25s ease, color .25s ease;
  }
  .cta-btn:hover, .cta-btn:focus-visible{background:var(--gold); color:#0b0905 !important;}
  .navtoggle{display:none; background:none; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--gold-bright); width:42px; height:42px; font-size:1.1rem; cursor:pointer;}
  a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright); outline-offset:3px;}

  @media (max-width:860px){
    .navlinks{
      position:absolute; top:76px; left:0; right:0;
      background:var(--bg-panel);
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
      flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:0;
      max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .3s ease;
    }
    .navlinks.open{max-height:420px;}
    .navlinks a{padding:16px 24px; width:100%; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,162,74,0.12);}
    .navlinks .cta-btn{margin:16px 24px; width:calc(100% - 48px); text-align:center;}
    .navtoggle{display:block;}
  }

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    padding:76px 0 60px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap:56px; align-items:center;
  }
  .crest-wrap{display:flex; justify-content:center;}
  .crest-wrap img{
    width:min(340px, 80%);
    filter:drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(201,162,74,0.18));
    animation:crestIn 1.1s ease-out both;
  }
  @keyframes crestIn{
    from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(18px) scale(0.96);}
    to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}
  }
  .eyebrow-line{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom:18px; color:var(--gold); font-size:0.82rem;}
  .eyebrow-line .rule{height:1px; width:36px; background:var(--gold-dim);}
  h1{
    font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 3.1rem);
    line-height:1.15; margin:0 0 10px; color:var(--cream);
    max-width:22ch;
  }
  h1 .bn{display:block; font-size:0.62em; color:var(--gold-bright); font-weight:600; margin-top:10px;}
  .hero p.lead{max-width:52ch; color:var(--muted); font-size:1.02rem; margin:18px 0 30px;}
  .hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--gold); color:#0b0905; padding:13px 26px; font-size:0.95rem; letter-spacing:0.01em;
    border:1px solid var(--gold); transition:background .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover, .btn-primary:focus-visible{background:var(--gold-bright); transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .btn-ghost{
    border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--cream); padding:13px 26px; font-size:0.95rem;
    transition:border-color .25s ease;
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover, .btn-ghost:focus-visible{border-color:var(--gold);}

  @media (max-width:860px){
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; text-align:center;}
    .hero p.lead{margin-inline:auto;}
    .hero-ctas{justify-content:center;}
    h1{margin-inline:auto;}
  }

  /* ---------- facts strip ---------- */
  .facts{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    background:var(--bg-panel);
  }
  .facts .wrap{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:0;
  }
  .fact{
    padding:26px 20px; text-align:center; border-right:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .fact:last-child{border-right:none;}
  .fact .icon{color:var(--gold); margin-bottom:8px;}
  .fact .en{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.05rem; color:var(--gold-bright); font-weight:600;}
  .fact .bn{font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){
    .facts .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .fact{border-right:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
    .fact:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  }

  /* ---------- section heading ---------- */
  section{padding:88px 0;}
  .sec-head{max-width:640px; margin:0 0 48px;}
  .sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto; text-align:center;}
  .sec-head .tag{color:var(--gold); font-size:0.82rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .sec-head.center .tag{justify-content:center;}
  .sec-head .tag .rule{height:1px; width:30px; background:var(--gold-dim);}
  .sec-head h2{
    font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.3rem);
    margin:0 0 8px; color:var(--cream);
  }
  .sec-head h2 .bn{display:block; font-size:0.6em; color:var(--muted); font-weight:500; margin-top:6px;}
  .sec-head p{color:var(--muted); max-width:56ch; margin:14px 0 0;}
  .sec-head.center p{margin-inline:auto;}

  /* ---------- services ---------- */
  .services-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1px;
    background:var(--line);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .service{
    background:var(--bg); padding:34px 26px; position:relative;
  }
  .service svg{width:34px; height:34px; color:var(--gold); margin-bottom:18px;}
  .service h3{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--cream);}
  .service h3 .bn{display:block; font-size:0.68em; color:var(--gold-bright); font-weight:500; margin-top:3px;}
  .service p{font-size:0.86rem; color:var(--muted); margin:10px 0 0;}
  @media (max-width:960px){.services-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  @media (max-width:560px){.services-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- doctors ---------- */
  .doctors-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:28px;}
  .doctor{
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:32px 26px; text-align:center; background:var(--bg-panel);
    position:relative;
  }
  .doctor::before, .doctor::after{
    content:''; position:absolute; width:16px; height:16px; border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);
  }
  .doctor::before{top:8px; left:8px; border-right:none; border-bottom:none;}
  .doctor::after{bottom:8px; right:8px; border-left:none; border-top:none;}
  .medallion{
    width:88px; height:88px; border-radius:50%; margin:0 auto 18px;
    border:1px solid var(--gold); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.6rem; color:var(--gold-bright); font-weight:600;
    background:var(--bg-panel-2);
  }
  .doctor h3{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.2rem; margin:0 0 2px; color:var(--cream);}
  .doctor .role{font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--gold); margin-bottom:12px;}
  .doctor .role .bn{color:var(--muted);}
  .doctor p.bio{font-size:0.86rem; color:var(--muted); margin:0;}
  @media (max-width:860px){.doctors-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; max-width:420px; margin-inline:auto;}}

  /* ---------- shop / flash sale ---------- */
  .shop-banner{
    border:1px solid var(--gold); background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(201,162,74,0.14), rgba(201,162,74,0.02));
    padding:38px 34px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap;
    margin-bottom:48px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .ribbon{
    position:absolute; top:14px; right:-42px; background:var(--gold); color:#0b0905;
    font-size:0.72rem; letter-spacing:0.04em; padding:5px 50px; transform:rotate(35deg);
    font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:500;
  }
  .shop-banner h3{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.5rem; margin:0 0 6px; color:var(--gold-bright);}
  .shop-banner h3 .bn{display:block; font-size:0.6em; color:var(--cream); font-weight:500; margin-top:4px;}
  .shop-banner p{color:var(--muted); margin:0; max-width:46ch;}
  .products-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:24px;}
  .product{border:1px solid var(--line); padding:0; background:var(--bg-panel);}
  .product .thumb{
    height:120px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--gold-dim);
  }
  .product .thumb svg{width:40px; height:40px;}
  .product .body{padding:18px 18px 22px;}
  .product h4{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.02rem; margin:0 0 3px; color:var(--cream); font-weight:600;}
  .product h4 .bn{display:block; font-size:0.68em; color:var(--muted); font-weight:400;}
  .product .price{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;}
  .product .price .now{color:var(--gold-bright); font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:600;}
  .product .price .old{color:var(--muted); text-decoration:line-through; font-size:0.82rem;}
  @media (max-width:960px){.products-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  @media (max-width:560px){.products-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- location / contact ---------- */
  .location{
    background:var(--bg-panel); border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .loc-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:48px; align-items:center;}
  .loc-illustration{display:flex; justify-content:center;}
  .loc-illustration svg{width:100%; max-width:340px;}
  .loc-details dl{display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:12px 18px; margin:22px 0 30px;}
  .loc-details dt{color:var(--gold); font-size:0.82rem; padding-top:2px;}
  .loc-details dd{margin:0; color:var(--cream); font-size:0.95rem;}
  .loc-details dd .bn{color:var(--muted); font-size:0.85rem; display:block; margin-top:2px;}
  .loc-ctas{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  @media (max-width:860px){.loc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- footer ---------- */
  footer{padding:50px 0 30px;}
  .foot-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:30px; flex-wrap:wrap; padding-bottom:30px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .foot-brand{display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center;}
  .foot-brand img{height:36px; width:36px;}
  .foot-brand .en{font-family:var(--font-display); color:var(--gold-bright); font-weight:600;}
  .foot-links{display:flex; gap:36px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .foot-links h5{font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--gold); margin:0 0 12px; letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .foot-links a{display:block; font-size:0.86rem; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px;}
  .foot-links a:hover{color:var(--gold-bright);}
  .foot-bottom{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-top:22px; font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--muted); flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;}

  .paw-divider{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; margin:0 0 26px; color:var(--gold-dim);}
  .paw-divider .rule{height:1px; width:64px; background:var(--line);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="bg-texture"></div>

<header>
  <nav class="wrap">
    <a class="brand" href="#top">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Vatara Pet Healthcare crest logo">
      <span class="brand-text">
        <span class="en">Vatara Pet Healthcare</span>
        <span class="bn2 bn">ভাটারা পেট হেলথকেয়ার</span>
      </span>
    </a>
    <button class="navtoggle" id="navToggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="navlinks" aria-label="Toggle menu">☰</button>
    <div class="navlinks" id="navlinks">
      <a href="#services">Services<span class="bn">সেবা</span></a>
      <a href="#doctors">Doctors<span class="bn">ডাক্তার</span></a>
      <a href="#shop">Shop<span class="bn">শপ</span></a>
      <a href="#location">Contact<span class="bn">যোগাযোগ</span></a>
      <a class="cta-btn" href="https://wa.me/8801639767640" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book Now</a>
    </div>
  </nav>
</header>

<main id="top">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap hero-grid">
      <div class="crest-wrap">
        <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Vatara Pet Healthcare crest — a shield bearing a dog and cat beneath a crown">
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow-line"><span class="rule"></span> Madani Avenue · Vatara, Dhaka</div>
        <h1>Care worthy of every creature under your roof.
          <span class="bn">আপনার প্রিয় প্রাণীর জন্য যত্নের এক নির্ভরযোগ্য ঠিকানা</span>
        </h1>
        <p class="lead">Vatara Pet Healthcare &amp; Veterinary Clinic looks after cats, dogs, rabbits, birds, guinea pigs, hamsters and more — right here in the Vatara neighbourhood of Dhaka.</p>
        <div class="hero-ctas">
          <a class="btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/8801639767640" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book an Appointment</a>
          <a class="btn-ghost" href="tel:01639767640">Call 01639767640</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FACTS -->
  <div class="facts">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="fact">
        <div class="icon">
          <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"><path d="M12 15.5c-3 0-6 1.6-6 4v1h12v-1c0-2.4-3-4-6-4z"/><ellipse cx="6.2" cy="9.5" rx="1.6" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="17.8" cy="9.5" rx="1.6" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="9.3" cy="6" rx="1.5" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="14.7" cy="6" rx="1.5" ry="2"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="en">Every Kind of Companion</div>
        <div class="bn">কুকুর, বিড়াল, খরগোশ, পাখি ও আরও অনেকে</div>
      </div>
      <div class="fact">
        <div class="icon">
          <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"><path d="M12 2 3 6v6c0 5 4 8.5 9 10 5-1.5 9-5 9-10V6z"/><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="en">Rooted in Vatara</div>
        <div class="bn">ওয়ার্ড ৩৯/৪০, ভাটারা এলাকায় সেবা</div>
      </div>
      <div class="fact">
        <div class="icon">
          <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"><path d="M4 21v-9l8-6 8 6v9"/><path d="M9 21v-6h6v6"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="en">100 Feet Road Address</div>
        <div class="bn">মাদানী অ্যাভিনিউ, ১০০ ফিট রোড</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SERVICES -->
  <section id="services">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head center">
        <div class="tag"><span class="rule"></span>What We Offer<span class="rule"></span></div>
        <h2>Services for every stage of your pet's life<span class="bn">আপনার প্রাণীর প্রতিটি পর্যায়ের জন্য সেবা</span></h2>
        <p>From routine wellness to surgical care, each visit is guided by a vet who takes the time to explain what's happening and why.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="services-grid">

        <div class="service">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M12 15.5c-3 0-6 1.6-6 4v1h12v-1c0-2.4-3-4-6-4z"/><ellipse cx="6.2" cy="9.5" rx="1.6" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="17.8" cy="9.5" rx="1.6" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="9.3" cy="6" rx="1.5" ry="2"/><ellipse cx="14.7" cy="6" rx="1.5" ry="2"/></svg>
          <h3>General Checkups<span class="bn">সাধারণ চেকআপ</span></h3>
          <p>Wellness exams that catch small issues before they become big ones.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="service">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M19 5l-6 6M13 5h6v6"/><path d="M9 9l-6.5 6.5a2 2 0 0 0 3 3L12 12"/></svg>
          <h3>Vaccination<span class="bn">টিকাদান</span></h3>
          <p>Age-appropriate vaccination schedules for lasting protection.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="service">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M6 3l4 4-1.5 1.5L4 4z"/><path d="M14 8l6 6-3 3-6-6z"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><path d="M11 13l-3.5 3.5"/></svg>
          <h3>Grooming<span class="bn">গ্রুমিং</span></h3>
          <p>Bathing, trimming and coat care that keeps pets comfortable.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="service">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M12 2v6M9 5h6"/><path d="M6 8h12l-1.5 11a2 2 0 0 1-2 1.8H9.5a2 2 0 0 1-2-1.8z"/></svg>
          <h3>Surgery<span class="bn">সার্জারি</span></h3>
          <p>Spays, neuters and soft-tissue procedures in a sterile theatre.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="service">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M7 4v5a5 5 0 0 0 10 0V4"/><path d="M9 4h6M12 15v4M9 19h6"/></svg>
          <h3>Dental Care<span class="bn">ডেন্টাল কেয়ার</span></h3>
          <p>Cleanings and extractions for healthier teeth and gums.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="service">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M9 3h6M10 3v5.5L5.5 16a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h9.6a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L14 8.5V3"/><path d="M8 14h8"/></svg>
          <h3>Diagnostic Lab<span class="bn">ডায়াগনস্টিক ল্যাব</span></h3>
          <p>On-site blood work and lab testing for faster answers.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="service">

<script>
  const toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  const links = document.getElementById('navlinks');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = links.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
    links.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  }));
</script>
